history.summary: NW4 lies within Barnet. London's largest borough by population, formed in 1965 from Finchley, Hendon, Barnet, Friern Barnet, and East Barnet. The Battle of Barnet, a decisive clash in the Wars of the Roses, was fought here in 1471.
